_readme: Lead scoring weights. total_score = fit_weight * fit_score + intent_weight * intent_score, each sub-score 0-100. All weights are adjustable — change the numbers, no code edits needed. icp.* is currently unpopulated placeholder data; until it's filled in, fit scoring runs in 'neutral mode' (see scoring.py) and every lead gets a fit_score of 50 with a warning logged, so the pipeline is honest about not yet having real targeting criteria.
